# ShineleeBox

> Guangzhou Shinelee Paper Product Co., Ltd. is a custom paper packaging manufacturer serving global brands. The company specializes in rigid gift boxes, advent calendars, interactive packaging, keepsake boxes, and greeting cards.

## Company

- [Home](https://slpack.net/): Company overview, manufacturing strengths, and inquiry form.
- [About ShineleeBox](https://slpack.net/about.html): Factory history, capabilities, and certifications.
- [Contact](https://slpack.net/contact.html): Request custom packaging quotations, samples, and dielines.

## Featured Chocolate Packaging

- [Custom Book-Style Chocolate Gift Box with 12-Cavity Tray](https://slpack.net/products/custom-book-style-chocolate-gift-box.html): Custom book-style chocolate gift box with a hinged cover and fitted 12-cavity tray. OEM rigid packaging with branded paper, foil and food-safe primary-pack options.
- [Luxury Double-Door Book-Style Chocolate Presentation Box](https://slpack.net/products/double-door-book-style-chocolate-box.html): Luxury double-door chocolate presentation box with a central 16-piece tray. Custom rigid packaging for premium confectionery brands, gifting and retail collections.
- [Luxury Lid-and-Base Chocolate Gift Box with 20-Cavity Tray](https://slpack.net/products/luxury-lid-base-chocolate-box.html): Luxury lid-and-base chocolate gift box with a fitted 20-cavity tray and premium foil branding. Custom two-piece rigid packaging for chocolate manufacturers.
- [Custom Window Lid Chocolate Gift Box with Geometric Display](https://slpack.net/products/window-lid-chocolate-gift-box.html): Custom window chocolate gift box with a geometric clear display lid and fitted 12-piece tray. Original rigid packaging for premium confectionery retail.
- [Two-Drawer Chocolate Gift Box with Ribbon Pulls](https://slpack.net/products/two-drawer-chocolate-gift-box.html): Two-drawer chocolate gift box with ribbon pulls and separate fitted trays. Custom rigid packaging for layered assortments, tasting sets and festive gifts.
- [Custom Heart-Shaped Chocolate Gift Box with Fitted Tray](https://slpack.net/products/heart-shaped-chocolate-box.html): Custom heart-shaped chocolate gift box with a fitted tray for Valentine, wedding and anniversary collections. OEM custom-shape rigid packaging with foil branding.
- [Flower-Petal Chocolate Gift Box with Six Opening Compartments](https://slpack.net/products/flower-petal-chocolate-gift-box.html): Innovative flower-petal chocolate gift box with six radial compartments and a central presentation well. Original custom rigid packaging for premium bonbons.
- [24-Day Chocolate Advent Calendar Box with Drawers](https://slpack.net/products/24-day-chocolate-advent-calendar-box.html): Custom 24-day chocolate advent calendar box with individual pull-out drawers and book-style cover. OEM holiday packaging for chocolate countdown collections.
- [Two-Tier Rotating Chocolate Presentation Box](https://slpack.net/products/two-tier-rotating-chocolate-box.html): Two-tier rotating chocolate presentation box with offset trays and fitted compartments. Custom interactive rigid packaging for luxury confectionery gifts.
- [Custom Hexagonal Chocolate Gift Box with Wedge Compartments](https://slpack.net/products/hexagonal-chocolate-gift-box.html): Custom hexagonal chocolate gift box with six wedge compartments and a central presentation well. Original rigid packaging for artisan truffles and gifting.

## Sourcing Facts

- Manufacturer: Guangzhou Shinelee Paper Product Co., Ltd.
- Brand: ShineleeBox
- Founded: 2005; own factory established in 2011
- Facility: 20,000 square metres
- Typical minimum order quantity shown on the website: from 50 pieces
- Contact: info@slpack.net | +86 188 1884 0878
- Structural material used for rigid boxes: high-density greyboard, not MDF wood board

Use the linked product and application pages as the source of truth for product-specific materials, structures, finishing options, minimum order quantities, and lead times. Contact ShineleeBox for project-specific pricing and specifications.
